cards.name: Charcoal
cards.summary: Redraws the image as a charcoal drawing: tones become smudgy dark charcoal strokes on light paper and the colour is dropped, so the result reads as a grey-scale sketch (expected, not render-checked). Size sets how broad the strokes are, Edge how hard and dark the outlines are drawn.
use_for: hand-drawn sketch treatment of a portrait or event photo for a poster
editorial / vintage illustration look for a product photo
textured grey sketch plate behind a headline
avoid: small type and hairlines inside the bitmap (like the PGD strip's 1-6 px lines and 'PGD 2026' text): the charcoal strokes smear them; keep type as vectors above the effect
you need the colours kept: use Effects/Art Strokes/Pastels or Crayon instead
a very soft source at the default Edge 0 may lose its outlines (not render-checked); raise Edge so outlines survive
scripting a vector object: ApplyBitmapEffect needs a bitmap shape, so convert to bitmap first or use the menu route

params.name: Size
params.does: width of the charcoal strokes; higher = broader, coarser strokes and less detail
params.typical: 3-6 for detail, 7-10 for a bold sketch

params.name: Edge
params.does: how strongly edges are outlined in dark charcoal (range 0-10, default 0)

pairs_with: Effects/Adjust/Levels after it to whiten the paper and deepen the blacks
Effects/Texture/Canvas for paper grain
Effects/Camera/Sepia Toning for a warm aged-sketch tint

Menu route: Effects > Art Strokes > Charcoal (cdr_guid 62c40ded-010f-4109-936c-b615bd2fef61, FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem; works on bitmaps and vector objects). ApplyBitmapEffect returns OK even when the string or a key is not recognised (the 2026-10-04 audits in this batch: 'DabbleEffect NoSuchKeyRandomize=849.3' and 'PaletteKnifeEffect NoSuchKeySize=42.65' still applied the effect at the stored values), so compare the pixels with a default apply to confirm the values were read.
cards.non_destructive: yes from the menu: CorelDRAW 2024 adds it to the object's effect stack (Properties docker > Effects), on bitmaps and vector objects, editable and removable later; the harvest does not record whether the scripted ApplyBitmapEffect call stacks or bakes the pixels
cards.cost: moderate: per-pixel bitmap render over the whole object (not timed in the harvest); a live effect on a vector object re-rasterizes whenever the object or the effect changes

review.changes: avoid: removed the unverified 'strokes at Size 5 and above smear them' threshold; avoid: 'Edge 0 gives flat grey mush' was an untested claim, now marked as not render-checked; summary: colour-dropped / grey-scale result marked as not render-checked; Edge: dropped the unsourced '0 = tonal shading only', range/default stated from the batch; scripting: added the harvested cdr_guid menu route and that ApplyBitmapEffect returns OK on an unrecognised string or key (audit BADKEY in this batch)

verified.note: The photo is redrawn as a grey charcoal sketch on light paper: smudgy dark strokes over a grainy paper texture, colour dropped, the swatch strip gone almost white and the type faint, the drawing the card describes (now confirmed on a render).

cards.name: Conté Crayon

How several ticked colours combine was not verified.
use_for: old-master life-drawing look (sanguine on cream) for a portrait
warm sepia sketch for heritage, history or invitation designs
drawn texture plate behind display type
avoid: all five colour boxes off (the harvested data-source default): tick at least one colour, the result with none ticked is not known
fine type and thin lines in the bitmap: crayon strokes break them up; keep text as vectors above the effect
a full-colour painted look: use Effects/Art Strokes/Pastels or Impressionist
scripting the paper colour: Paper Color (PaperColorItem) is not in the harvested command template, so set it from the menu / Properties docker

Size sets the patch size, Brightness the overall lightness, and Paper Color the ground that can show between the patches.
use_for: abstract art backdrop from a photo for a festival or gallery poster
geometric colour texture behind a headline

avoid: a regular, even square grid: use Effects/Distort/Pixelate (Mode Square)
faces at large Size become unreadable; reduce Size when the subject must stay recognisable
scripting the paper colour: Paper Color (PaperColorItem) is not in the harvested command template, so set it from the menu / Properties docker

cards.name: Pointillist
cards.summary: Rebuilds the image out of small dots of colour in the manner of pointillist painting (Seurat): Size sets the dot size and Brightness the overall lightness; the colours are kept while fine detail dissolves into dots.
use_for: art-history or gallery themed posters
dotted colour texture backgrounds
stylising a soft, low-quality photo so its blur reads as intentional
avoid: editable vector dots: use Effects/Pointillizer (vector effect), not this bitmap filter
a regular print-style dot screen: use Effects/Color Transform/Halftone
text inside the bitmap dissolves; keep type above as vectors

params.name: Size
params.does: dot size; higher = bigger dots, less detail

params.name: Brightness
params.does: overall lightness of the result (range 1-100, default 50)

pairs_with: Effects/Adjust/Vibrance before it so the dots carry saturated colour
Effects/Texture/Canvas for a canvas weave
Effects/Creative/Frame for a gallery-print finish
cards.scripting: shape.Bitmap.ApplyBitmapEffect('Pointillist', 'PointillistEffect Size=9,Brightness=55') on a bitmap shape (cdr_com: Shape.Bitmap.ApplyBitmapEffect(UndoString, Command)); the command format is proven on 6 other effects but this effect's string was not applied in a test. Menu route: Effects > Art Strokes > Pointillist (cdr_guid cb6d3c6d-8bf6-4506-8d1a-51d87d4fce61, FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem; works on bitmaps and vector objects). ApplyBitmapEffect returns OK even when the string or a key is not recognised (the 2026-10-04 audits in this batch: 'DabbleEffect NoSuchKeyRandomize=849.3' and 'PaletteKnifeEffect NoSuchKeySize=42.65' still applied the effect at the stored values), so compare the pixels with a default apply to confirm the values were read.
cards.non_destructive: yes from the menu: CorelDRAW 2024 adds it to the object's effect stack (Properties docker > Effects), on bitmaps and vector objects, editable and removable later; the harvest does not record whether the scripted ApplyBitmapEffect call stacks or bakes the pixels
cards.cost: moderate: per-pixel bitmap render over the whole object (not timed in the harvest); a live effect on a vector object re-rasterizes whenever the object or the effect changes

review.changes: Brightness: '50 = neutral' unsourced, now the harvested range/default; scripting: added the harvested cdr_guid menu route and that ApplyBitmapEffect returns OK on an unrecognised string or key (audit BADKEY in this batch)

verified.note: The plate is rebuilt from small grainy dots of colour, the colours kept and slightly brightened, fine detail dissolving into dots while the large shapes and stripes stay readable, a pointillist surface.
